words.gloss: the true value of the help

literal: The help's measure is not the help itself; the help's value is of the measure of the nobility of those who received it.
translation: The value of a help is not determined by the assistance itself; it is measured by the noble character of those who receive it.
modern: ஒருவர் செய்த உதவியின் அளவு, அந்த உதவியின் தன்மையைப் பொறுத்தது அன்று; உதவி பெற்றவருடைய தகுதியின் அளவைப் பொறுத்தது ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how the true value of a helpful act is determined. The poet states that the worth of a favor does not lie in its material size or effort. Instead, the true measure of the help is defined by the noble character and gratitude of the person who receives it. A small act of kindness done to a highly virtuous person becomes immense, while a large favor done to an ungrateful person loses its value.
